folder_path: The folder where the exported files will be saved to.
fbx_type: Ascii ends up writing bigger files, but it's useful for debugging output.
up_axis: Exported scene up axis. If different from the current scene, conversions would be performed.
NOTE: Conversion currently covers only skinned meshes and animations
triangulate: Triangulate the selected meshes on export, leaving them in their current state in the scene
include_anim: Whether to include animation (if any) or not.
file_name: The base file name to use for export. Note that this can get the currently selected
object name appended when multiple objects are selected, and multi-file export option is chosen.
start_frame: The whole animation timeline start frame to export.
end_frame: The whole animation timeline end frame to export.
anim_only: Whether to export only the skeleton with animation, leaving the mesh(es) out.
Makes for lighter weight animation export files
browse: Browse to the folder/directory to export to.
open: Opens the export folder/directory path in the default file manager for your OS.
NOTE: On Linux, some OS's do not match the same framework Maya is using, and won't work correctly
from_bookmarks: Creates the clips in the clip panel starting from the bookmarks on the timeline.
NOTE: you need bookmarks already created to use this feature.
to_bookmarks: Create timeline bookmarks from the existing clips
NOTE: you need clips created and setup in the panel below to use this feature
save_config: Saves the current configuration to file.
load_config: Loads the current configuration from file/
as_takes: Export the clips to the file as takes.
NOTE: if this is off, each clip will be exported to its own file.
strip_namespaces: Removes namespaces from the exported content.
parent_to_world: Ignored if ANY deformer is found in your selection (skins or blendshapes)
to_center: Move the selection to the center of the scene.
Ignored if ANY deformer is found in your selection (skins or blendshapes)
zero_rotations: Zero-out any rotations found on the selection.
Ignored if ANY deformer is found in your selection (skins or blendshapes)
sing_file: Export the current selection to a single file.
multi_file: Export the current selection to separate files.
NOTE: Ignored if the selection only contains one item.
embed_media: Include textures along with the exported geometry
